changes.evidence: Penny's Place is Karen's past job: in Daredevil S3 episode 10 ('Karen'), a flashback shows her working at her father's diner in Fagan Corners, Vermont, years before she came to New York. A past group goes first, keyed to her first title. Where it sits now (after the New York Bulletin, at Daredevil S3) reads as if she left the Bulletin to work at the diner. In S3 she is still at the Bulletin until she rejoins Matt and Foggy as a partner.

The Marine Corps and the Savannah police are Carl Lucas's past, before Seagate. Luke Cage S1 tells it: in episode 11, Diamondback says the preacher got the judge to let Carl join the Marines; in episode 4 and episode 13 he is shown and told as a former Savannah cop. As past groups they go first, keyed to his first title (Jessica Jones S1). The record has them after Pop's Barber Shop and Harlem's Paradise, as if he left Harlem's Paradise for the Marines. The 'left' list (Jessica Jones S1, Luke Cage S1, Daredevil: Born Again S2) stays as it is.

owner_calls.question: Does Matt's resistance (Daredevil's Army) end in the Daredevil: Born Again S2 finale, so the person should end Independent (with a 'left' at Daredevil: Born Again S2)? In episode 8 ('The Southern Cross'), the resistance's war against Fisk ends: Fisk accepts the state's deal, resigns and leaves New York, and Matt and Karen talk about getting back to normal life now the campaign is over. Nothing on screen says the group disbands. The MCU wiki marks it Defunct and lists Matt, Karen and Josie as former members. The same ruling applies to all three records.
options: Keep Matt's resistance as the last stage (no on-screen disbanding)
Add Independent at Daredevil: Born Again S2 and a 'left' at Daredevil: Born Again S2 (the group ends with Fisk's fall)
owner_calls.evidence: Born Again S2 episode 8: Fisk is ousted, and the Anti-Vigilante Campaign and the resistance's fight are over. Matt is arrested, and Karen goes free.

owner_calls.question: Daredevil S1 episode 2 ('Cut Man') shows Jack throwing fights for pay for Roscoe Sweeney (the Fixer) and his man Silke. The wiki calls Sweeney his employer, and Sweeney's men kill Jack after he refuses one last dive. Should Jack get a stage for Sweeney's fight-fixing operation? The screen never names that operation, and the dataset has no name for it.
options: Add a stage for Roscoe Sweeney's operation at Daredevil S1 (owner to choose the name), then Independent with 'left' at Daredevil S1 when he breaks the deal
owner_calls.evidence: Daredevil S1 episode 2: Sweeney tells Jack to go down in the fifth round against Creel. Jack wins instead, and Sweeney's hitmen kill him.
